reviews.text: Caring, kind, attentive staff. Even though my cat doesn’t love the vet, they do everything to make it easier for him and it’s very much appreciated.

A very genuine thank you to the Leslieville Animal Hospital Team!  Their thoughtfulness and care is second to none.  They treat your pet as if she/he was their own family member.  Big thanks and big hugs.
Kind and conscientious pet care! They explain everything well and listen too.
They took amazing care of our princess!!

We’ve had such a wonderful experience with Leslieville Animal Hospital and can’t say enough good things about the team there.

Our boxer, Mojito, can be a little anxious, especially in unfamiliar environments, but everyone at Leslieville Animal Hospital has always been incredibly patient, gentle, and caring with him. All of the vet techs are so kind and make a genuine effort to help him feel comfortable and safe. You can really tell they love animals and understand that every dog has a different personality and needs a different approach.

What we appreciate most is how they treat Mojito like more than just another patient. They take their time with him, give him lots of attention, and never make us feel rushed. Seeing how comfortable he has become with the staff gives us so much confidence bringing him in.

The entire team is friendly, knowledgeable, compassionate, and always welcoming. It means a lot to know that when Mojito needs care, he’s surrounded by people who genuinely care about him.

We’re very grateful to have Leslieville Animal Hospital looking after our boy and would absolutely recommend them to any pet owner looking for a veterinary team that treats your pet like family. 🐾❤️
Took our 7 week old kitten in for her first vaccination…always the best care at Leslieville Animal Hospital.

I called in with a concern about my pet and the hospital couldn’t see me on this same day but the girl on the phone was so kind and helped connect me with a nearby clinic who could. She was so helpful and calmed me down a lot, thank you for your kindness!
I have been taking my cat here for years and have only had positive experiences. They are very gentle with her and treat her with care. It’s very sweet and gives me the peace of mind I need.
This is a very caring clinic and we love bringing our dog here!
It was a really good yearly visit. Dr. Lauren took the time listen and offer Zephyr the care he needed. Thanks again!

The vet was very informed, patient, and kind with me and my cat. She answered many questions i had about his health and vaccines. They also did a complimentary nail trim for me as my cat won’t let me trim his nails. Great place to bring your pet!
Always a great experience - the staff as so kind and friendly. They always listen to my concerns and treat effectively. Rocky loves going to the vet!
Great staff, nice vet and were very helpful with all my questions

Leslieville vet is great they are thorough with my 2 new cats and didn't overdo the cost for everything . The staff is terrific and thorough also l would recommend this vet to everyone.  This is the best hospital around
We love our cat more than anything and this is the only vet we have trusted with his regular care.

Called and spoke to Carrie about my sick cat, and clinic facilities, and the help and advice was amazing! Thank you so much! Your knowledge and kind helpfulness means everything when navigating complex illness with aged cats. Would happily rely on you again in a heartbeat.
We noticed that our Pepper had some gunk in her eye, called the clinic and they were able to squeeze her in within an hour. Really appreciate your care of her.
We love this clinic! The staff are so friendly and professional; it’s wonderful to have such an incredible clinic for our dog.

Dr Date takes great care of our elderly Dogue de Bordeaux Oliver. The other support staff including the ladies at reception, the technicians are also very sweet and caring. Despite being a little stressed at the notion of a vet visit we think Oliver likes going to Leslieville because of all the attention he gets. And the treats 💕💕💕 …
Exceptional vet clinic who cares for my lil’ buddy. Friendly staff, great service.
We appreciate the excellent rating!
Always receive incredible care at this place. I’ve been taking our dogs here for 14 years

Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Zeynep! 🐾

Warmly,

Olivia
Practice Manager
Thank you for the 5 stars! We strive to provide excellent service and are glad you had a positive experience.
So good to our pup Maddie, booked us in at short notice to accommodate a major concern. Lovely, professional and understanding. Thank so much!

We have taken both of our cats to Leslieville Animal Hospital for years and we have always found them to be warm, friendly, helpful and informative about our cats health and care. Both the veterinarians and support staff are absolutely wonderful. Highly recommend anyone looking for a great vet for their pet.

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review, Mark! Hi to Ripley 🐾❤️

Warmly,

Olivia
Practice Manager
My American Bully George has been going to Leslieville Animal Hospital since he was a puppy. They really care and he loves his vet visits! He is treated like a king 👑 …
Very Professional took my cat Oggy, they handled him very well even though he is very antisocial. 💖 Hopefully he gets better soon. …

Thank you for the 5-star review, Danny! I'm so happy to hear that you had a great visit with us. 

Warmly,

Olivia
Practice Manager
Friendly, professional, and attentive. They truly care.
The vets here take such good care of our little Sacha! She’s been here for years!

I was dog sitting my daughter's Boston and she threw up 7 times the previous day, so I called Leslieville and they were able to get us in early the next morning.  The vet that examined her was great. Checked her out, said I could just wait and see if she got better,  instead of going to the extreme and doing tests. I really respect a vet that gives the least invasive action first,  and definitely the least expensive.
Everybody was excellent as usual

The vet saw my cat and said an ultrasound was suggested as a next step to determine what is the reason her liver levels are high. I did not to that ultrasound at Leslieville Animal Hospital.

The Front desk staff have emailed me several times to ask how she is doing. Annika said in her email to me that Scribble is suffering from a "liver mass." I didn't do an ultrasound with Leslieville Animal Hospital. How do the front desk staff diagnose and communicate a condition to me via email? This is actually alarming and troubling to read. The Receptionist diagnosed her in an email without an ultrasound.   Here is the email where the front desk staff diagnosed Scribble.

"The condition we are referring to would be the issues caused by the liver mass: the yellowing of her skin and eyes. Are you still able to give fluids? Please let us know if you have any questions.
Kindly, Annika"

Annika is not a vet. She is a front desk receptionist

Front desk staff keep emailing asking how she is doing. The vet that saw her 4 weeks ago has never once called to see how Scribble is doing.

I would never go here with a pet, especially a pet in a critical care situation or emergency ever again.
Very courteous staff at this clinic. Never had an issue.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Marion. We're so glad we exceeded your expectations.
Love the family energy

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review, Farrah. Tell Baxter we say hello ❤️🐾

Warmly, 

Olivia
Practice Manager

We appreciated how you were able to see our dog within 24 hours and perform the necessary procedure. The follow up call the next day to check on how he was doing was a nice touch. Great service from start to finish. Our dog actually pulls us in to your clinic whenever we walk by to get a treat.

Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Barbara! I'm so happy to hear that you had a great visit with us. 

Warmly, 

Olivia
Practice Manager
Our Boston Bill had an ear infection and we were able to see the vet same day. Very friendly and knowledgeable staff, and up front about cost. I would recommend.
Wonderful bedside manner and caring for my kid.
Thank you for the exceptional service, care and love for Samra!

We truly appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review, Julien. I'm so happy to hear that you had a 5-star experience. Say hello to Peaches for us!

Warmly,

Olivia
Practice Manager
Your 5 stars warms our hearts, Jennifer! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience with us.
Your positive feedback motivates us, Nizam! We look forward to seeing you again soon.

Dr. Arinda and her team were wonderful with my dog — very gentle, thorough with the exam, and explained everything in clear, easy-to-understand terms. I also appreciated that she didn’t push for unnecessary tests and focused on what was truly needed. All of the staff were lovely as well. Highly recommend!
Your 5-star review means so much. Thank you for your vote of confidence!
Have been very happy with the care and support they have provided us and our fur babies over the years.
The team is kind, knowledgeable, and always patient—they make every visit great

Dr. Avery is fantastic! Provided tailored care and practical recommendations for my older cat. It’s the first time my cat was not stressed out during a visit and I felt that he really listened to my concerns and preferences.

We have been at Leslieville Animal Hospital for over 5 years now.  I’m genuinely and sincerely so impressed with the level of care, concern, and all-over demeanor of each and every staff member at this Vet Clinic!!! At their best, they go above and beyond at the most critical moments - calls with test results, when these are very important to care for our family pet. We are fortunate that, due to the overall care our pet has received, we have only had on urgent care situation arise.
Advice for all - get pet insurance! It makes decisions a lot easier, at the most difficult of times.
Please consider this vet for your family!

Leslieville has taken such good care of our cats. They have gone above and beyond in terms of service and professionalism. The doctors have always taken time to explain what’s happening in clear relatable terms and the vet techs are amazing. Everyone there makes us feel so welcome. We would highly recommend them
Thanks for the stellar rating! We love exceeding clients' expectations.
Dr. Suhasini was wonderful with Pepper and super thorough. She was respectful, knowledgeable and I trust her and the team for impending surgery and dental cleaning. Thanks so much!

Kobe & I love everyone at Leslieville Animal Hospital.  It's always important for us to feel comfortable with our dog caregivers & everyone at Leslieville succeeds.  All the staff is exceptional & they make my fur baby feel great after each visit.  Thanks again for all you do. 🐕🐕 …
Very friendly, prompt and helpful!
Hi Sheila, thanks for posting a review! If there is anything we can do to achieve a 5-star rating, we would appreciate your feedback. Please give us a call.

My dog Benji loves going here. He is alway given pets and treats when he walks in the door.

For this visit, Dr Arinda answered all my questions about what would be involved with getting a teeth cleaning and we were overall happy with the consultation.

Very disappointed with Leslieville Animal Hospital. We switched clinics back in 2021 because it was consistently difficult to get appointments, but we continued purchasing our pet’s food through their online store. Recently, I received an email saying the food was out of stock, so I looked into ordering directly from Rayne. Rayne required veterinary approval, which Leslieville refused, stating they hadn’t seen our pet in a long time. While I would normally understand that reasoning, it’s frustrating because they had no issue approving the same food for years when it was purchased through their own online store. This felt inconsistent and disappointing, and it didn’t leave me feeling that my pet’s best interests were the priority.

Vet was excellent and personable. She obviously loves dogs.
Prices have gone up, but that’s true everywhere, I guess.
The staff is always pleasant, informative and thorough.
Your 5-star review means so much. Thank you for your vote of confidence!
Thanks to the attentive and gentle staff here, my miniature schnauzer is never afriad of going to the Vet and is well on his way to feeling better. Thanks to you all!

This was our first visit with an adopted elderly cat and we were delighted with the thoughtful, comprehensive care provided by the whole team. We will definitely return for any future needs. Thank you from Dizzy!!
Leslieville animal hospital is a great clinic! My dog is always treated with such great care and patience.
Your positive feedback motivates us, Justin! We look forward to seeing you again soon.

Have been taking my cat here for a few years now. Always receive great and friendly service and although a visit to the vet is far from his favourite thing to be doing, the staff are always caring and making him feel comfortable. All options, procedures and costs are thoroughly explained. Highly recommended!
Thank you for the 5 stars, Dave. We're so glad we exceeded your expectations.
Our 13 year old Lab Charley has been coming to Leslieville Animal Hospital throughout her life. She's always welcomed by the staff with treats and has received great care from the vets.
The vets and all the staff at Leslieville Animal Hospital are the best!

Hi James, we are sorry to hear your experience has left you feeling this way. We would appreciate your feedback on how we can improve your experience in the future. If you would like to discuss the matter further, please give us a call at (416) 463-8387.

The LESLIEVILLE Animal Hospital is amazing! My dog doesn’t go to this animal hospital but on NYE my dog got a bad eye infection and I called to see if they had an appointment and they took me the same day! I’m forever grateful as it was during the holidays and if they didn’t take me, then my baby boy would have suffered so I’m very thankful to the LESLIEVILLE Animal Hospital! 😃
And the staff is wonderful! They made me feel welcomed and were very helpful and reassuring.
Dr. Murphy was great and Sitka was a happy girl, or at least as happy as she could be with a paw infection!
Your 5 stars warms our hearts, Marlene! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience with us.

This vet hospital is superb. My son went to this hospital with his dog and when my cat stopped eating I called them because they are much closer than the clinic I was going to. They took me on as a new patient the day I called and I got an appointment that day. The vet examined Fig and also did blood work and some tests right then. They were very clear on pricing and terms that I needed to know. I think both vets that have seen my pet and my sons were lovely, kind and caring.and I would recommend this hospital to anyone needing a vet.
We're thrilled you gave us a top rating!

The staff at LAH are the best. They've been there for us, and more critically for our animal friends from brand new pups through to end of life care. Can't say enough about how great they are. Thank you!

Leslieville Animal Hospital is always a great experience, even under stressful circumstances. My dog was bitten by another dog and bleeding from his paw. Dr Su and team took him in right away, made him super comfortable, and addressed all of his injuries thoroughly. I think I was likely more traumatized than the dog was (who was happily eating all their treats) but they handled everything with care and kindness.
We're thrilled you gave us a top rating!

My dog Teddy had a wonderful visit at Leslieville Animal Hospital! The entire team was warm, patient, and incredibly caring from the moment we walked in. They took the time to make Teddy feel comfortable, explained everything clearly, and treated him like family. It’s clear that everyone here truly loves what they do. I’m grateful for the excellent care and would highly recommend Leslieville Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a compassionate, professional veterinary team!

Such great staff. Incredible doctors. We’ve had some very stressful situations that were approached with calm and care at Leslieville Animal Hospital. When our first dog had cancer, they were very quick to diagnose and walk us through our options with no pressure. I am forever grateful for the care we were offered during Mordy’s final months. Now, our new dog David has had some adventurous calamities and we’ve always been offered ample attention especially in a recent emergency. Very highly recommended.

Leslieville Animal Hospital is an important part of keeping my cats healthy and helping them live their best lives.  I find taking the cats to the vet stressful and really appreciate the supports the staff and vets put in place to make it as easy as possible.  We've always had great, thoughtful, expert care and I appreciate how hard the team works to do a very stressful, hard job well.
Highly recommend Dr. Avery! Absolutely lovely and extremely helpful and accommodating! Thank you for making a veterinarian visit the best it can be
Thank you for the 5 stars, Rick. We're so glad we exceeded your expectations.
We work hard for 5-star ratings like this. Your review helps us grow. Thank you!
Dr. Murphy is great. She thoroughly explained options and costs.
The staff is so sweet and gentle with our doggie Max. We’re really grateful for the guidance we receive from the vet and all the people that work there.

This is the best vet clinic. My baby boi, Claymore, is treated so well here. Staff are always so gentle with him and hes never uncomfortable when theyre handling him.
He was just neutered and they went through every step of the procedure and reassured me with any anxieties I had. He's healing very well and even offered a free check up for a week after to make sure he's healthing exactly as he should.
Can't recommend these guys enough
As always, Leslieville Animal Hospital treated my dog and me with compassion and real knowledge. I've been a client for 18 years.
Grateful to have such a quick appointment and my concerns addressed
Goose always loves his visits to Leslieville Animal Hospital! The friendly staff make him feel like a VIP and Dr. Murphy takes very good care of him. He especially loves being rewarded with a treat!
We work hard to earn 5-star reviews like yours, Mark! Thanks for brightening our day.
Thanks for the stellar rating! We love exceeding clients' expectations.

They’re the best!! All the staff there are super friendly, I completely trust them with my cat! They helped me to get my cat back to a healthy weight and she couldn’t be happier!! Thanks for all you do!
Delilah always gets the best care! 🥰 …
A 5-star review is the highest praise. Thank you for your glowing recommendation!

The staff here are so empathetic and caring. Truly advocates for animals of all kinds. They are also extremely accommodating with appointments. If you have a pressing concern they do their best to get you in ASAP. I can’t say enough positive things about this clinic and their wonderful staff

I always have a wonderful experience at Leslieville animal hospital. They take such great care of my cat, Oakley. The team is welcoming from the moment we walk in, and everyone is incredibly helpful and kind.

They handled Oakley’s exam and blood tests with so much professionalism and care—explaining everything clearly and making sure he stayed calm throughout the process.

I’m grateful for their compassion and expertise, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary team. Oakley is definitely in good hands here!
The vetvwas thorough and explained things well. All the staff were friendly and professional. .
Great vet. Always friendly and super kind. Transparent and honest about procedures, costs, etc.
Your 5 stars warms our hearts, Ryan! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience with us.
Awesome vets! Always look after. Quick, responsive, consultative. Thank you!!!
Love this vet. Very gentle with my pet and knowledgeable. Will never go elsewhere.
Our lil Emma was spayed yesterday. Staff were very thoughtful and caring to both our pup and family. They took the time to follow up the next day- answered our questions and open to listen.

Leslieville Animal Hospital went above and beyond their duties to help my dad and I with our dog Togo who can be a little crazy at times, he got off his leash and he was going after other dogs and the Leslieville team really helped us to get Togo under control and back on his leash and they helped us get into our uber so no one got hurt. This is the best care I’ve ever received. If you want a vet that cares about the pets and the people, this is the vet for you.
Your 5-star review means so much. Thank you for your vote of confidence!
excellent! super caring & compassionate.

Leslieville Animal Hospital has taken such good care of our rescue pup from her gotcha day to emergencies we have had. Their care, expertise, understanding and commitment to our dog's well being is unparalleled to any vet we have dealt with. Incredibly helpful and thoughtful staff, techs and vets. Your pets are in great hands.

My dog Moose has been struggling with allergies for several months. After multiple in-and-out vet visits at our previous vet, Leslieville Animal Hospital was a breath of fresh air. Dr. Arinda took the time to explain the multiple factors that can cause allergies and plotted a multi-step plan to tackle the allergies and get his skin back to normal. In talking through each step, she did a fantastic job explaining the associated costs and didn’t just start with the most expensive treatment — that level of honesty and transparency really stood out. Moose also appreciated the hypoallergenic treats! After months of uncertainty, I feel very reassured to know we have a plan.

Leslieville Animal Hospital has been a trusted team of wonderful people who have taken great care of my dog Poppy. She had certainly come to them with a variety of issues. All met with professional and personal care. Dr Sue has made such an incredible difference in Poppy’s life. From shuffling to running and playing again. Thanks team. Debra Toffan
Lovely staff.  Excellent care for my cats.
We're thrilled you gave us a top rating!
FYI - owned by VetStrategy
The staff and doctors are very very considerate with my pet needs and I’ve always been there for us in case emergency uncontrollable situation so I give them 11 out of 10

After many years of being upsold and under serviced by  corporately owned Vet Clinics, Leslieville Animal Hospital has returned to its initial service quality. Our family’s values around  pet care is what could be described as a preference for minimalist intervention and treatment.
We choose to assume a level of risk with our pet care which means turning down suggested tests, blood work and some vaccines.
In the past 3 months we have finally found a vet who “gets us.”  Dr. Arinda Muntean understands that when absolutely necessary for our pets’ health—we are willing to pay for the care our pets  require. We are happy to approve care that is indeed needed, rather than over-the-top suggestions for unnecessary tests and treatments that are often recommended primarily for enhancement of clinic profitability.

We trust our Leslieville Animal Hospital Veterinarian, Dr. Arinda Muntean. Dr. Muntean takes the time to provide the information we need and she is patient with our questions and queries about why a treatment protocol is required. Dr. Muntean respects and offers a treatment plan that fits with our  minimalist (but completely adequate) approach to pet care.

It is such a relief and pleasure to be working with a veterinarian that is committed to providing a standard of care that is oriented to serve the real needs of our pets. When we see Dr Muntean, we know we are not going to have to content with and push back on the “corporate upselling” that we have been contending with since the small vet clinics have been purchased by mega vet companies (the corporatization of vet clinics across  North America).

We also trusted the recommendations of dental surgeon Dr. Date   She called us during Mac’s dental surgery to discuss which teeth extractions were recommended and why. And Dr Date also let us know that they could store a tissue sample  for up to 30 days, so we could decided at a later date  if it was advisable to send the sample to pathology.

So Bravo! to Leslieville Animal Hospital for returning to  the kind of vet care  we enjoyed when you Dr Steve first opened in 2007.
Welcome Back.

Thank you to the team! Over the past 10+  years—no matter how busy the day, when I called to order food for our cat (TD 3.85 kg bag) the team was always pleasant and more than happy to help.  The team was also there for us when our cat’s health was terminally failing. They helped us connect wirh Dr. Curran, as we really wanted to say goodbye to our love, at home. Though the immense grief still hurts everyday without our cat, we still picture him lying on our front porch, with his tail lightly waving us adieu, as if at peace and knowing he was surrounded by love. Dr. Curran generously provided a warm and thoughtful house visit and we are forever grateful. And to the Leslieville  team: the work you do every day, matters. Thank you.
We work hard to earn 5-star reviews like yours, Hayley! Thanks for brightening our day.
Your 5 stars warms our hearts, Rick! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience with us.

Great team at this clinic - I’ve just started taking my cat there and so happy to have found such a great place. Apart from being obviously very knowledgeable, everyone I dealt with recently when my cat was sick was extremely caring and I really liked the fact that everything they did was explained thoroughly, giving me the cost of each procedure and medication and allowing me to make a decision about whether to get further tests done during that visit, rather than insisting I did  and charging more. And the after care was also amazing - following up to see how she was doing and giving me detailed instructions for monitoring her progress. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone in the area.

I agree with the previous review that Leslieville Animal Hospital has become transactional and cold in the recent months.  I have been a client there for 2 years and with 4 of my kitties.  I have spent thousands with them including emergency overnight support for one of my kitties who passed away.

For over 2 weeks I have been trying to get them to refer one of my kitties to a dermatologist, but they don't respond or say "they are busy".

I even walked in yesterday to see what's going on and the receptionist (who knows me as I've been there dozens of times) looked at me as if we never met before and was completely unhelpful.

So sad that you trust these people to take care of your babies and then if there's no money involved for them, they treat you like you don't exist.

Front desk staff named Emily has no manners & full of attitude. If you are thinking of bringing your pet here be prepared to fight for proper attention to your loved ones.

They have a new booking system - 2 visits ago my dog waited 1.5 hours cause they had no record of my appointment.  And in that 1.5 hours; Emily asked me zero times if my dog wanted water…wait room is basically a greenhouse…legit.

My last appointment the doc didn’t show cause of emergency. So we got a locum 20-30 min behind schedule. Honestly didn’t care… but kinda wanted our usual vet cause my dog has Addisons disease. Locus (Spencer) made recommendations of my dog stopping agility training…doesn’t know my dog at all. Nor didn’t ask about her stress levels (or joy levels) during her “safe space” training in the appointment. This dude just jumped to his recommendation point blank…”don’t do agility cause your dog has Addisons”.…my pup has her best friends in agility and the agility trainers dog also has Addisons. It’s healthy for her according to our specialist but “Spencer just made a blanket statement to stop after 1 question about her. Vet Spencer then spent time arranging a tennis match with me…I actually replied to his text (why not he was a nice person just a careless caregiver). In terms of his vet skills he is rather careless & doesn’t refer properly to specialist’s instructions. I’ll also highlight that I did respond to his text to arrange tennis …with him giving no response. My advice to him - get to know your pet better and care less about using company time to ask me if I know your former tennis friends & tell me about ur childhood at Kew Gardens.  You are literally practicing caregiving irresponsibly by not referring to specialist instructions. And thanks for wasting my time exchanging numbers and texts.  Anyways, Spencer isn’t a vet that demonstrates care….visit him if only if u want to listen more about his childhood & less on your pet.

Now I write about my appointment today. Emily back at it again…she rolls her eyes at u and speaks in a condescending tone.  Emily has issues with people politely waiting. She puts her finger up and says “wait” Totally brutal people skills. Her appointment giving skills were again brutal today….this time telling me I was 10 minutes late (I don’t think so); so now my dog will receive a shorter visit. Actually made a walk into the patient room to tell me this after I’d been waiting 5 minutes.  Ya ok Emily…looks like your appointment giving skills are off again…. she speaks with a patronizing tone.  She rolls her eyes if u have concerns …she lacks empathy and demonstrates very little care.

Absolutely devastated and deeply disappointed by how transactional and cold Leslieville Animal Hospital has become.

Over the years, I spent thousands of dollars here without hesitation because it was for my dog. But every visit felt like another upsell — another $500–$1,000 invoice — without continuity or real compassion. One vet told me she had 6–9 months to live. The next vet had no idea what I was talking about. Then a different doctor, after describing her latest appointments and symptoms, told me to “consider the humane option.” I did. I put Sydney down. And I regret it every day.

I called and emailed to let them know. No one responded. No call. No email. Not even a generic message of sympathy. Just an email of her blood results, after she died, but as per my request. Again - not even an flippin “SORRY TO HEAR”. After all the money, the appointments, the trust — not a word. That’s what hurt the most.

It’s clear this clinic operates as a business first, not a place of care. And I’m left with guilt, heartbreak, and no support from the people I trusted with my dog’s life. Shameful.

The vets and staff here are so kind and thoughtful.  My dog actually pulls me in the door, he loves going to the vet!  I appreciate that they always let me know the costs upfront before they take any action and offer alternatives if they can to help save me money. Great people who care so much for my pet’s wellbeing.
Dr. Avery is so personable and, because I have a senior cat, he doesn't put pressure to do extra tests. I have been going to Leslieville Animal Hospital for 14 years now. Great staff.
Your 5 stars warms our hearts, Jody! We're thrilled you enjoyed your experience with us.

My cat has seen several vets here and they were all excellent, handling him with kindness and expertise. They explain everything thoroughly and have answered any questions I’ve had. He’s needed to give some samples and the vet techs and vet assistants are able to collect them quickly and with minimal stress to my cat. The front desk team are also very nice and helpful, they were even able to accommodate getting him in ASAP before the long weekend when he started having sudden health concerns and followed up on treatment the next day.
He means the world and then some to me, so I appreciate that they’ve taken good care of him!
I Debbie and butter cup saw the Dr  she was not feeling well the dog  is sick  but she  is getting better thank you  Debbie good job 😀 …

Amazing first visit with the Leslieville animal hospital. We got our rescue pup about 2 weeks ago and were searching for a vet nearby. All of the staff are super professional, warm, and kind. Would recommend to anyone looking for a great clinic in the area - thank you for taking care of Kolt!

My dog has had to adjust to many new vets over the years, following me through frequent moves. Each time meant starting over, and unfortunately, we’ve also encountered a few vets who didn’t handle my anxious pup with the care he needed. So I walked into this clinic with a heart full of worry—registering as a new client, transferring medical records from the previous clinic, and booking our first appointment.

But to my relief (and even a little surprise!), everything went better than I could have imagined. Thanks to the amazing teamwork of Dr. Brittany and technician Victoria, my sensitive and nervous dog was able to go through his vaccinations, blood tests, and check-up with calm and confidence. Their gentle and professional approach made a world of difference, and I was genuinely touched by the way they made both of us feel so safe and supported.

I’m incredibly grateful to have found such kind and capable people. Of course, I hope we don’t have to visit too often—because that means my dog is healthy—but it’s such a comfort to know that we have a clinic like this to come back to whenever we need.
My local vet for my puppy! Very friendly staff and everything we need in a vet. Thank you.
Wonderful and caring staff.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Mikhail. We're so glad we exceeded your expectations.

Many thanks to the clinic and the team ( Great people )I’ve been dealing with them for the past 15 years .Unfortunately I had to put down one of my pooch recently ,I’m so grateful ANNIKA was so helpful during this difficult  time for me and my other pooch I can’t Thank her enough .

I came here with my cat oreo and everyone was so nice to him. Such nice and cooperative staff. I wanted to move my appointment and they were so accommodating. Even the doctor was so calm with him and helped me with travel details for him. I got an email with detailssss the same day. How thoughtful. Also the pricing is transparent here. Didn’t have to pay a penny above. I love the fact that i found the perfect hospital for my oreo 🫶🫶

Initially, i loved this practise - very friendly and professional.  However, over time I had 2 significant issues:
1. The veterinarians changed almost every visit - which impacted continuity of care.
2.  My dog was diagnosed with an eye condition - resulting in regular vists to a referral specialist.   This was ongoing, until I took my dog to another vet who identified the issue as non-existant.    I would do anything for my dog, but clearly this was collusion.

Overall, you can find better.

The staff at LAH have consistently been kind, compassionate and expert in providing care to three of our family dogs and counting. They are approachable, open and excellent to work with in supporting the well being of our animal friends. Special shout out to vet tech Sam who is the best!

2025 review:
We've been taking our fur babies to Leslieville Animal Hospital for around a decade. In that time, with multiple cats and a dog, we have dealt with many different doctors and team members from vet techs to front of house staff at this clinic. Everyone demonstrates a great deal of sensitivity and compassion and they go the extra mile to ensure a high standard of care.

As a long standing client, I can say that I have not experienced any difference in the quality of care related to the change in ownership a couple years ago.

I feel there is a great deal of transparency with respect to treatment suggestions as well as the associated costs. You are always presented with options and ultimately the decision is yours on how to proceed. Estimates are detailed, costs are explained, and adequate time is always taken to answer any questions you may have or to address your concerns.

Even during the most challenging and painful moments we've had to endure with our furry family members, we have always felt they were in good hands, and we have felt supported.

Older review from 2023:
Wonderful staff and nice clean clinic. Everyone is friendly, compassionate and professional. My dog actually enjoys going there. My cats don't enjoy it, but they don't seem to hate it, and that alone is a big achievement since they don't like going anywhere  :-)

I called this morning to inquire about appointment availability and pricing for my kitty Oliver who had an eye infection, and not only did they have a same day appointment available, but they were also super transparent about pricing and said “we understand if you need to take time to consider that, feel free to call us back if needed”. From that grace, understanding, and patience alone, I knew this was the right place to come. Jennifer was my receptionist and she was so helpful with all my questions, and Brittany was my vet and was SO good with Oliver, non-judgmental, very compassionate and answered my questions as well. I really do recommend this vet clinic if you need a trusted safe place to take your pet! <3

Leslieville Animal Hospital is an amazing medical centre. All there Doctors are very caring of all their patients and they make you and your pet feel special and important.  The love and the care that they have given my little George who is very sick has been very much appreciated. They improve on his meds when they are needed. He is a sweet little boy who is full of life and very loving.  I am very thankful for his Dr. Kerry, God Bless.

This clinic has changed quite dramatically since I first reviewed it. It is now owned by the Vet Strategy Corporation. I didn't realize at first that the ownership had changed as I think the transition was during Covid lockdowns, I was super disappointed that Dr. Avery after seeing my dog for over a decade didn't even let me know that he was no longer working at the clinic. It feels like one big sales pitch when you get in the door. I took my elderly dog there a few weeks back and ~$800 later all that I could be told was that her liver enzymes were high (they have been for ~5 years) and that more tests were needed. I took her to a different clinic who weren't pushing every possible test on us, and she is doing much better. I would recommend looking into a family owned clinic for your pet.

AMAZING, FANTASTIC, CONSIDERATE, TOTALLY ABOVE AND BEYOND ALL MY EXPECTATIONS! Did I say amazing!? ;)  I can't say enough good things about Leslieville A.H. I absolutely would & have recommend this clinic to anybody I know.
